purpose: Reviewed design input for a future versioned runtime catalog, not a current registry or generation switch.
vanilla_retention: Both remain explicit regional candidates with a nonzero configurable share, not blanket replacements.

family_contract.property_rule: All forms use the layer material preset; geometry, own loot and recipes remain form-specific.

art_note: Swatches are selected artistic targets, not measurements or universal specimen colors.

rocks.art_direction: Cream/buff matrix; subtle bedding and sparse bioclastic detail.
rocks.formation_summary: Carbonate sediment accumulates and lithifies; later uplift may expose former marine deposits.

rocks.art_direction: Charcoal gray; fine planar cleavage, distinguishable from granular greywacke.
rocks.formation_summary: Low-grade metamorphism of mud-rich sediment produces slaty cleavage.

rocks.art_direction: Gray-green body with silver/sage highlights and fine wavy foliation; painted silky mica sheen, not a requirement for shaders.
rocks.formation_summary: Metamorphism of fine-grained sediment produces fine mica/chlorite-rich foliation with a silky-looking cleavage surface.

rocks.art_direction: Dark umber body; restrained rust/ochre mottling and ooids.
rocks.formation_summary: Iron-rich sedimentary varieties include ooidal rocks with iron-bearing silicates, carbonates and oxides.

rocks.art_direction: Blue-black mafic grains with scattered subdued feldspar flecks.
rocks.formation_summary: Slow crystallization of mafic magma forms intrusive rock; both oceanic crust and continental intrusions are possible.

rocks.art_direction: Navy body with blue-gray foliation; preserve a dark mean value.
rocks.formation_summary: High-pressure, relatively low-temperature metamorphism associated with subduction can produce blue sodic amphibole.

rocks.art_direction: Dark olive/forest green with narrow pale-green veins.
rocks.formation_summary: Hydration alters ultramafic parent rock; water-rock reaction matters, not just greater burial.

rocks.art_direction: Near-black reddish-brown matrix with sparse dark copper-brown mica flecks; no luminous red grains.
rocks.formation_summary: Mica-rich lamprophyric magma intrudes fractures as dikes; the selected dark reddish-brown variety is supported by documented mica lamprophyres.

occurrence.cross_chunk_rule: canonical global dike identity with bounded neighborhood queries
occurrence.placement_rule: replace eligible natural deep host blocks only; preserve ores, bedrock, fluids and constructed blocks
occurrence.note: This is a structural intrusion, not an equal-area blanket province or horizontal stratum; configurable finite thickness and extent remain implementation work in #11/#22.

legacy_only.note: Keep all 16 existing forms placeable; preserve legacy-world selection under its pinned generator version.

migration_notes: Preserve all four original rock IDs and shipped shape IDs.
Gabbro moves from surface to deep in the new generator only; older generator selection must remain stable.
A shared gabbro block material-preset change also affects existing placed blocks globally; document it explicitly before release.
Eight active families plus legacy quartzite imply 144 registered block forms if the existing complete-family design is retained.
